description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare that the Excise Duty on Water, Cigarettes, vehicles, etc., and the concessionary Excise Duty on Locally assembled vehicles etc., and the applicable rate for the purpose of calculating the Excise Duty payable on person transport vehicles including station vagons and racing cars w.e.f. 21.11.2015
